preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
LP burn must be enabled (lpBurnEnabled = true)
Sufficient time must have passed since last LP burn (block.timestamp >= lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency)
Uniswap V2 pair must hold MarvinInu tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, wait for lpBurnFrequency (default 3600 seconds) to pass since lastLpBurnTime, then execute a sell transaction to the Uniswap pair. This will trigger autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() which burns a percentage (default 0.25%) of LP tokens, reducing total supply and increasing the attacker's relative token holdings. Alternatively, use manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens() directly if cooldown period has passed.
